premise: Fox is too loud to hear anything; Rabbit teaches him to stop and listen, and they hear Owl's soft good evening.
inspiration: The folk listening game, turned against the fable of the fast one: the gift Fox lacks is not speed but quiet, and the forest answers when he finds it.
lesson: Listening lets the world talk to you.

en-US.title: Fox Learns to Listen
en-US.text: Fox {fox:hop x2} was never quiet. He ran, he jumped, he shouted: [excited] HELLO, FOREST! And the forest said… nothing at all. [sad] Why doesn't anyone talk to me? asked Fox. Rabbit {rabbit:pulse} sat down in the grass. [whispers] Sit with me, he said. And don't say a thing. {rabbit:live} Rabbit's ears went up. He listened. He looked left, and right, and nibbled a clover leaf. Fox tried to sit still. His tail {fox:shake} twitched. His paws wiggled. {canvas:sunset 0.6 25s} But slowly, slowly… he listened too. {sfx:leaves} A leaf rustled. {sfx:brook} A brook bubbled. [softly] And from the old tree came a voice, very soft: {sfx:hoo} hoo-hoo. It was Owl {owl:fade-in}, saying good evening. [happily] Fox {fox:hearts} smiled a very quiet smile. The forest had been talking all along.

es-ES.title: Zorro aprende a escuchar
es-ES.text: Zorro {fox:hop x2} nunca estaba callado. Corría, saltaba, gritaba: [excited] ¡HOLA, BOSQUE! Y el bosque no decía… nada de nada. [sad] ¿Por qué nadie me habla?, preguntó Zorro. Conejo {rabbit:pulse} se sentó en la hierba. [whispers] Siéntate conmigo, le dijo. Y no digas nada. {rabbit:live} Conejo levantó las orejas. Escuchó. Miró a la izquierda, a la derecha, y mordisqueó una hoja de trébol. Zorro intentó estarse quieto. Su cola {fox:shake} se movía. Sus patas se meneaban. {canvas:sunset 0.6 25s} Pero poco a poco… él también escuchó. {sfx:leaves} Una hoja susurró. {sfx:brook} Un arroyo borboteó. [softly] Y desde el viejo árbol llegó una voz, muy suave: {sfx:hoo} uh-uh. Era Búho {owl:fade-in}, que les daba las buenas noches. [happily] Zorro {fox:hearts} sonrió con una sonrisa muy calladita. El bosque llevaba todo el rato hablando.

leaves.prompt: a single dry leaf rustling in a light breeze

brook.prompt: a little brook bubbling over stones, a short soft burble

hoo.prompt: one soft, friendly distant owl hoot, two gentle notes
